title: Late Renewal Reinstatement Fee Schedule — Northgate Memberships
content:
| Schedule item | Days the membership has lapsed when the renewal is paid¹ | Fee added to the renewal fee of the lapsed membership |
|---|---|---|
| No reinstatement fee | 14 or fewer | none |
| Late renewal reinstatement fee, middle band | 15 to 45 | 5.00 dollars |
| Late renewal reinstatement fee, upper band | more than 45 | 10.00 dollars |

¹ The days a membership has lapsed are counted in calendar days from its expiry date to the day the renewal is paid, the expiry date itself not counted.

**Schedule wording.** A renewal of an expired membership of Northgate Memberships paid more than 45 days after the expiry date carries a late renewal reinstatement fee of 10.00 dollars, a renewal paid 15 to 45 days after the expiry date carries a late renewal reinstatement fee of 5.00 dollars, and a renewal paid within 14 days of the expiry date carries no late renewal reinstatement fee. The fee is added to the renewal fee of the lapsed membership.

## Counting the days (hypothetical dates)

| Expiry date | Renewal paid | Days lapsed | Reinstatement fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| 31 January 2027 | 14 February 2027 | 14 | none |
| 31 January 2027 | 15 February 2027 | 15 | 5.00 |
| 31 January 2027 | 17 March 2027 | 45 | 5.00 |
| 31 January 2027 | 18 March 2027 | 46 | 10.00 |

The day after the expiry date is day 1; 1 February is therefore day 1 of the lapse for a 31 January expiry date.
